scope: Prove the reference workflow from a cloned checkout: git clone -> npm run setup -> npm start, owner sign-in, scoped write, fresh step-up reveal, transient clear, member denial, restart persistence, plaintext-at-rest scan and provider backup/restore (Requirement N30).
source_identity_method: SHA-256 over sorted C30-owned path bytes, NUL separators and each file SHA-256; excludes docs/evidence and plans/ handoff files to avoid recursive self-reference

environment.npm: 11.17.0 (toolchain lock pins npm 11.9.0; the executing npm reports 11.17.0)
environment.host_note: Shared development host: the clone reused the already-provisioned local provider containers instead of provisioning fresh ones, and the clone source came from a working-tree snapshot because the C30 change is not committed. Both deviations are recorded as limitations.

fixtures.provenance: repository-authored synthetic workflow, identities and secret sentinel; matches ops/local/keycloak-realm.json and contains no real credential material

asserted: owner PKCE sign-in through the Keycloak form
HTTP 201 write at version 1 with no plaintext in the rendered page
reveal without step-up -> 401 step_up_required and no plaintext element
fresh step-up reauthentication -> 200 reveal, Cache-Control no-store, plaintext equals the fixture sentinel
dialog close clears the DOM plaintext
reopened reveal demands a new step-up and shows no cached plaintext
member listing is owner-scoped (0 of 0) and a direct member reveal -> 403 access_denied

commands.command: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...
commands.summary: Build and vet clean; all Go packages pass, including tests/ in 18.4s.
generate-web-data, tsc, vite build (267.19 kB JS) and Go engine build succeeded.
23 web/contract tests passed, including launcher, readiness, configuration and fixture-provenance suites.
30 Playwright tests passed, including the new C30 real-provider workflow spec.

commands.command: KEYHELIX_CLONE_WORKTREE=1 KEYHELIX_REUSE_PROVIDERS=1 KEYHELIX_CLONE_RESTORE=1 npm run test:clone
commands.summary: Cloned the working-tree snapshot, ran npm run setup, proved web-only startup separately, ran the C30 browser spec in the clone, proved composed readiness, restarted the app and re-revealed the secret, found 0 sentinel occurrences under .local-data/engine and .local-data/providers, then snapshotted/restored OpenBao and re-revealed after restore.

observed.clone_tree: working-tree snapshot (index clone requires the task to be committed)
observed.setup: npm ci (34 packages) + build inside the clone

restore.revoked_grants_still_revoked: not exercised in this run; grant revocation is covered by C22 tests and the member-denial check

limitations: A clean supported Linux host was not available; providers were reused on the shared development host and the clone came from a working-tree snapshot.
C30 therefore remains planned in plans/progress.json until a clean-host clone -> setup -> start -> restart -> restore run is executed and recorded.
Grant-revocation durability across restore is asserted by C22 tests, not by this C30 run.
The full C01-C30 evidence chain required by the acceptance text was not re-run end to end on a clean host.
